content:
This styleguide example shows the structure of the element. Before you publish, replace it with a statement based on an audit of your own site. Desiderio provides semantic components, visible focus styles, alt-text fields and contrast checks for theme tokens. Whether your site meets WCAG 2.2 AA depends on your content, configuration, integrations and testing.

What Desiderio supports

  • Interactive components come with keyboard and focus patterns. Check them with your own content and integrations.
  • Shared landmarks and heading rules give pages a sound structure. Editors are still responsible for a logical heading order.
  • Image fields store alternative text. Decorative icons are hidden from assistive technology.
  • Automated tests for structure and token contrast help catch regressions.

What remains your responsibility

Content that editors enter, embedded media, uploaded documents, third-party extensions and complete user flows still need a human review. This example does not replace a conformance audit or a legal review.
